name: Product Price Color Manager
author: Md Arafat Islam

sections.description:
Product Price Color Manager lets you easily customize WooCommerce product price colors directly from the WordPress dashboard.

You can control how prices look across your site without editing theme files or writing CSS.

What this plugin allows you to do:

  • Change regular price color globally
  • Change sale price color globally
  • Set custom price colors for specific products
  • Override theme default price colors safely
  • Use different colors for regular and sale prices

How the color system works (Priority Order):

  1. Product-specific price color (highest priority)
  2. Global price color
  3. Theme default price color

This ensures that individual product settings always override global settings when set.

The plugin works with standard WooCommerce price classes and is compatible with most WooCommerce-supported themes.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the product-price-color-manager folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to the plugin settings page to set global price colors
  4. Edit any product to apply specific price colors
sections.faq:
Can I change my theme’s default WooCommerce price color?

Yes. The plugin overrides the theme’s default WooCommerce price colors using safe and standard methods.

Can I set different colors for individual products?

Yes. You can assign custom price and sale price colors per product. These settings override global colors.

Can I use different colors for regular price and sale price?

Yes. Regular price and sale price colors can be set separately, both globally and per product.

Will this plugin work with any WooCommerce theme?

The plugin works with most themes that follow standard WooCommerce markup and CSS classes.

Do I need coding knowledge to use this plugin?

No. All settings are available through the WordPress admin dashboard using simple color fields.

Does this plugin change product prices or calculations?

No. The plugin only changes how prices are displayed visually. It does not affect pricing logic.
